The '''Hydians Auction House''' was a structure that originally stood in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Nayli]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="SoR" /> The auction house eventually moved to [[Epica]]. [[Lestra Oxic]] bid against a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] for a piece of [[Republicana]] art at the location.
